rationale: The September 24 SOK 3.2 Help matrix documents Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 with Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0 and places the Operator upgrade first. The September 8 project changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The Queue secretKeyRef change is specific to Index & Ingestion Separation. The General Terms entry is separately scoped to SOK 3.0.0. No 11.x pairing follows.

exclusions: No universal Kubernetes maximum, Enterprise 11.x compatibility, app pairing, Cloud availability or authorization is established.
